title: Sleep tracking device
summary: A device that tracks and improves your sleep.
whyTempting: Sleep is a growing wellness obsession.
whyItFails: Data without action. Knowing you slept badly doesn't fix it. Wearables already do it. Watches and rings track sleep. Hardware economics. Inventory and returns are costly.
whatWouldChange: Closed-loop products that act (temperature, light, sound) rather than just measure.

attempts.notes: Bedside sleep tracker with a pillow clip; most staff laid off in June 2017.

reasons.detail: Data without action: Knowing you slept badly doesn't fix it.
Wearables already do it: Watches and rings track sleep.
Hardware economics: Inventory and returns are costly.
